description: This Java source file defines the class MyCloudProvider which extends the Android DocumentsProvider to manage and expose documents stored in a custom file hierarchy, acting as a mock cloud storage provider. It implements various typical document provider functionalities such as querying roots, documents, creating, deleting, opening, and searching documents, and handles URI to File conversions. The class also includes setup code to preload sample files for demonstration purposes.

classes.name: MyCloudProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of a DocumentsProvider that simulates a cloud storage backend within the device's internal storage for demonstration purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider and preloads dummy files into internal storage.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns a cursor describing the available root(s) for this provider.

methods.name: queryRecentDocuments
methods.description: Queries and returns the most recently modified documents under a specific root.

methods.name: querySearchDocuments
methods.description: Searches documents for a given query string, returning matching files.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Returns metadata info about a specific document.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Lists all child documents under a given directory.

methods.name: openDocumentThumbnail
methods.description: Provides a thumbnail AssetFileDescriptor for a document.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a file for reading or writing based on the mode provided.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document in a specified directory with a given name.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document identified by its document ID.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the specified document.
